src/components/common/filters/filters.js renders &lt;Row gutter=8&gt; of &lt;Col span=6&gt; Form.Items — a 12px label over a 44px control — and a trailing row of Show More · Clear filters · Search. Field list: src/tenant/common/filters/listingFilters.js. Every number here is either declared in the product or measured from data/live/listings.capture.json ; the token comments say which.
TBC — the input's focus ring and the select's open state are not rendered by the harness (nothing is focused in a capture). antd's are 0 0 0 2px of the primary at 10% — unverified here. The Show More icon is MdOutlineDoubleArrow with the product's .flipX class; it points right in LTR on the harness render, so it is left unflipped.
